_doc: Ready-made animal models (Quaternius 'Farm Animals Animated', CC0, art/models/quaternius) for the families that have one; the others stay code-built (AnimalBuild). file: the FBX; yaw: degrees to turn it so it faces +x; fit: how long the whole animal is against the rig's body length; roles: what each surface of the mesh is, 'coat' (the item's colour), 'accent' (its accent colour) or 'keep' (as modelled); walk_from: borrow the Walk of another model (they share a skeleton) when the model has none; eye: how big its eyes are against the usual (a small head wants bigger ones); walk_rate: how fast its walk plays against its speed.
